Power in Light.t: Smite and Penance {1}% stronger on targets with Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain
Power in Light.sig: Your Smite and Penance spells deal #% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

Wand Specialization.sig: Increases your damage with Wands by #%.

Twin Disciplines.t: Instant spells deal and heal {1}% more
Twin Disciplines.sig: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by #%.

Silent Resolve.t: {1}% less threat, stuns, fears and silences {2}% shorter
Silent Resolve.sig: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by #% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by #%.

Holy Precision.sig: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by #%.

Martyrdom.t: No pushback for {2} sec after a crit hits you
Martyrdom.sig: Gives you a #% chance to gain Focused Casting for # sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by #%.

Mental Agility.t: Smite, Holy Fire and instant spells {1}% cheaper
Mental Agility.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by #%.

Inner Focus.sig: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by #% and increases its critical effect chance by #% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

Improved Power Word: Shield.sig: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by #%.

Meditation.sig: Allows #% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Improved Inner Fire.t: Inner Fire +{1}% armor and {2} more charges
Improved Inner Fire.sig: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by #% and increases its total charges by #.

Improved Mana Burn.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by # sec.

Soul Warding.sig: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by # sec and reduces its mana cost by #%.

Penance.t: Holy volley that damages an enemy or heals a friend, 3 bolts over {4} sec
Penance.sig: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing # Holy damage to an enemy, or # healing to an ally, instantly and every # sec for # sec.

Renewed Hope.t: +{1}% heal crit on targets with Weakened Soul
Renewed Hope.sig: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain #% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by # sec.

Divine Aegis.t: Heal crits shield the target for {1}% of the heal
Divine Aegis.sig: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing #% of the amount healed. Shields up to # damage and lasts # sec.

Power Infusion.t: +{1}% spell damage and healing on a target for {2} sec
Power Infusion.sig: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by #% for # sec.

Twilight Focus.sig: Gives your spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Improved Renew.sig: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by #%.

Holy Specialization.sig: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by #%.

Spell Warding.sig: Reduces all spell damage taken by #%.

Divine Fury.t: Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal {1} sec faster
Divine Fury.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by # sec.

Holy Nova.t: Damage enemies and heal your party within {3} yards
Holy Nova.sig: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing # to # Holy damage to all enemy targets within # yards and healing all party members within # yards for # to #. These effects cause no threat.

Blessed Recovery.t: Heal {2}% of a big hit over {3} sec
Blessed Recovery.sig: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than #% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal #% of the damage taken over # sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

Inspiration.t: Heal crits give the target +{1}% armor for {2} sec
Inspiration.sig: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by #% for # sec.

Holy Reach.sig: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by #%.

Improved Healing.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by #%.

Searing Light.t: +{1}% Holy damage, Holy Fire can make Holy Nova free
Searing Light.sig: Increases your Holy damage done by #%, and gives a #% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

Holy Binding.t: Flash Heal on others heals you for {1}% as much
Holy Binding.sig: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for #% as much. This healing generates no threat.

Litany of Light.t: Alternating heals refund {1}% of their base cost
Litany of Light.sig: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to #% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

Spirit of Redemption.t: Keep healing for {1} sec after you die
Spirit of Redemption.sig: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for # sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

Spiritual Guidance.t: Heal bonus up to {1}% of Spirit, damage up to {2}%
Spiritual Guidance.sig: Increases your spell healing by up to #% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to #% of your total Spirit.

Spiritual Healing.sig: Increases the amount healed by your spells by #%.

Prayer of Mending.t: Heal that jumps from player to player as they take damage
Prayer of Mending.sig: Places a spell on the target that heals them for # the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within # yards. Jumps up to # times and lasts # sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

Shadow Focus.sig: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by #%.

Blackout.t: {1}% chance Shadow spells stun for {2} sec
Blackout.sig: Gives your Shadow damage spells a #% chance to stun the target for # sec.

Spirit Tap.t: Double Spirit for {3} sec after a kill
Spirit Tap.sig: Gives you a #% chance to increase your Spirit by #% for # sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, #% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

Improved Mind Blast.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by # sec.

Improved Shadow Word: Pain.t: Shadow Word: Pain lasts {1} sec longer
Improved Shadow Word: Pain.sig: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by # sec.

Shadow Reach.sig: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by #%.

Improved Psychic Scream.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by # sec.

Mind Flay.t: Shadow channel over {2} sec that slows by {3}%
Mind Flay.sig: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing # Shadow damage over # sec and slowing their movement speed by #%.

Improved Mind Flay.t: Each Mind Flay tick {1}% stronger than the last
Improved Mind Flay.sig: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals #% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

Dark Inspiration.t: Mind Blast and Mind Flay give your party +{1}% Spirit
Dark Inspiration.sig: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by #% for # sec.

Vampiric Embrace.t: Your party heals for {1}% of your Shadow damage
Vampiric Embrace.sig: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for #% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for # sec.

Shadow Weaving.t: Stacking +{2}% Shadow damage taken, up to {4} times
Shadow Weaving.sig: Your Shadow damage spells have a #% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by #% for # sec, stacking up to # times.

Silence.t: Silence for {1} sec, interrupts the cast
Silence.sig: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for # sec and interrupting their spellcasts for # sec.

Devouring Contagion.t: Devouring Plague {1}% cheaper and spreads on death
Devouring Contagion.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by #%. Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to # nearby enemies within # yds for the remaining duration.

Early Demise.t: Shadow Word: Death +{2}% crit under {1}% health
Early Demise.sig: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below #% health by #%.

Darkness.sig: Increases your Shadow damage done by #%.

Shadowform.sig: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by #%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by #%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by #%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by #%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
